handbookNote: Batch 2 depth expansion for the Georgia Notary practice-question pool -- same source grounding as batch 1 (Official Code of Georgia Annotated (O.C.G.A.) Title 45, Chapter 17, Article 1 (SS 45-17-1 -- 45-17-20) and Article 2 (SS 45-17-30 -- 45-17-34)), going deeper via scenario/application questions that apply already-covered statutory rules to new concrete fact patterns, procedural/timeline mechanics (application, fee flow, renewal, seal loss, revocation/resignation), cross-references between related Code sections, and a dedicated cluster of questions grounded in the real annotated case law and Georgia Attorney General opinions accompanying this chapter (e.g. Anthony v. Am. Gen. Fin. Servs. on notary-fee civil liability, Land v. Burkhalter and Poppell v. Lanier on notary disqualification, Smith & Bondurant v. Meador on the notary 'holds over'/de facto officer doctrine) -- not invented content, all tied to specific Code sections or annotations. Price matches batch 1 at $0.99: Georgia has no graded notary exam (O.C.G.A. S 45-17-8(h) requires GSCCCA-administered training with 'no separate exam'), so this remains education-only practice content, not exam prep.
